# Shallows (`shallows`)

Clear knee-deep water over rippled sand, netted with sunlight.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location, weather
- Cost: medium (~5.0 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Shallows, Low Tide

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `depth` | Depth | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `sea` | Sea State | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.55 |
| `clarity` | Clarity | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.75 |
| `sun` | Sun Height | slider | 5 … 85 | 40 |
| `live` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `lapse` | Time Lapse | slider | 0 … 60 (step 1) | 0 |
| `clouds` | Clouds | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.3 |
| `weather` | Weather | menu | 0 Live · 1 Clear · 2 Partly Cloudy · 3 Overcast · 4 Fog · 5 Rain · 6 Storm · 7 Snow | 0 (Live) |
